Detection Feature Matching

Computer Vision Pipeline

Computer vision systems often combine image preprocessing, feature extraction, object detection, and geometric reasoning. See the OpenCV website for a widely used vision library.

Object Detection

Object detection predicts object classes together with bounding boxes. The following image is an example of a vision-related asset.

Typical Detection Workflow

  1. Load an input image.
  2. Run preprocessing.
    • Resize the image.
    • Normalize pixel values.
  3. Run the detector.
  4. Apply post-processing such as non-maximum suppression.

Example Code

import cv2

image = cv2.imread("image.jpg")

if image is None:
    raise ValueError("Image could not be loaded")

print(image.shape)

Feature Matching

Feature matching compares local descriptors between two images. Classical examples include SIFT, ORB, and learned local features.

Method Type Main Property
SIFT Hand-crafted Scale and rotation invariant
ORB Hand-crafted Fast binary descriptors
SuperPoint Learned Neural keypoints and descriptors
